❓ Help — Prof. GARRF-Anna v55.3

  • Non-Verbatim Enriched Live Class: Prof. Anna never reads raw PDF lines in Live Class. She sends each topic to the AI model to rephrase naturally AND adds intuition, background theory, and real-world engineering examples alongside your PDF.
  • Worker Access: Use Founder’s Access for a temporary five-hour demonstration, or Teachers’ Access to save a teacher’s own Worker URL on this computer. Picture Setup is only for replacing Prof. Anna’s pictures.
  • 5 Anna Poses: Place anna.png (or anna.jpeg), anna_attention.jpeg, anna_thumbs.jpeg, anna_point.jpeg, and anna_open.jpeg in the same folder, or upload replacement pictures in Picture Setup to cache them offline.
  • Live Doubts (Type or 🎤 Voice): Students can interrupt with spoken or typed questions. Anna is instructed to ground answers in the uploaded material, cite page references where available, distinguish general explanation, and admit when the source does not establish an answer. Unclear speech is sent back for repetition rather than guessed.
  • Lecturer Corrections: Use ✏️ Corrections on any live slide to copy the board text, paste or rewrite it, apply edits, and save the corrected deck with the course before exporting.
  • Anna Research Series: The featured series is based on the previously uploaded 2008 ASCE paper on multiple PZT–structure interaction.
